summary: A change that helps a drink last longer on the shelf leaves a processor unable to use the empty bottle.
realLife: An industry consultant told the Missourian that the coating on a new half-liter bottle extended its shelf life but broke down below the temperature used to process PET.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: coated packaging and buyer acceptance.

turns.what: The crew sets the coated bottles aside for a separate buyer.
turns.pulledBy: The processor can separate the incompatible containers.
turns.writesBack: The rest of the shipment proceeds to its buyer.

turns.what: The recycler asks the supplier what changed in the packaging.
turns.pulledBy: The buyer declines the coated stock.
turns.writesBack: A refunded bottle may still lack a recycling outlet.
